title: a host seam that cannot apply on this box's platform is not offered, so the install gate can reach green on Windows
intention: cairn install does not offer a host seam that declares it applies only to another platform, so on Windows the gate reads green once every seam that can apply here has verified.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: on akiendell the installer dry-run check prints [OFFERED] usage-widget-hook and exits 1; gather_host_seams returns one seam; run_verify(seam) returns (False, '/usr/bin/bash: line 1: jq: command not found'); ~/.claude/usage-cache.json is absent; installer.py install() reads no platform field
traces_to: Law 4: the gate is physics only if it can be satisfied where it runs; Law 3: the offer was measured on the box, not assumed; Law 7: the skip carries a named reason.
how: Give a host-seam intention an optional platforms declaration (the platforms it applies to; absent means every platform), have install() in the installer skip, with status skipped and a named reason, a seam whose platforms exclude this box's, and declare usage-widget-hook as linux only. The proof drives install(dry_run=True) over a scratch intentions dir holding one seam for another platform and one for this platform. Red first: the proof is red on HEAD because the other-platform seam reads offered.

clauses.claim: a host seam that declares another platform is reported skipped with the platform named, never offered, and its verify is not run
a seam with no platforms declaration, and one declaring this platform, are offered or verified exactly as before
on akiendell the installer's dry-run check no longer lists usage-widget-hook as a red

decisions.text: D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.

measured.saw: on akiendell the installer dry-run check prints [OFFERED] usage-widget-hook and exits 1; gather_host_seams returns one seam; run_verify(seam) returns (False, '/usr/bin/bash: line 1: jq: command not found'); ~/.claude/usage-cache.json is absent; installer.py install() reads no platform field
measured.how: ran the installer with --dry-run --check via the venv python; ran gather_host_seams and run_verify directly; read installer.py install() lines 468-544
